commits.message:
Update lab4.vhd

Half-way of our code from sunday

Main revison of concept and sketchs

This is a revison that includes PCB modifications (made it optional both
SMD and TH components) and software corrections.

Datalogger V2 (temperature and humidity)

The second version of my datalogger, featuring temperature readings
(LM35 and DHT11) and humidity (DHT11), saving data to a SD card on a
Freescale FRDM-K64F ARM cortex-M4 board.

Datalogging into a SD card

Datalogging room temperature (from LM35 sensor) into a micro SDHC card, using the FRDM-K64F development platform and the online mBed compiler.

Turn LEDs on according to the switched pressed

Changes the color of a RGB led according to the switched that is
pressed, in the Freescale Freedom FRDM-K64F development platform

Initial release of RGB led blinking

Blinks every color of a RGB led sequentially, in the Freescale Freedom
FRDM-K64F development board

Schematic diagram for the circuit

This schematic was drawn in Fritzing.

small textual editions

Those editions do not affect the code itself

Initial release

This program reads the IDHT11 temperature/humidity sensor, along with
the LM35 temperature sensor (for comparison reasons only) and show all
this data in a 16x2 LCD display

Initial release of the datalogger firmware

Reads Temperature (LM35 and DHT11), humidity (DHT11) and light lever
(LDR) and saves it to a microSD card, while keeping track of the time
with a DS1302 (timekeeping) from Maxim. Uses the Freescale FRDM-K64F
development board (ARM Cortex-M4)
